A prayer of David. Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
Let your ears be open to my voice, O Lord, and give me an answer; for I am poor and in need.
（大衛的祈禱。）耶和華啊，求你側耳應允我，因我是困苦窮乏的。
Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.
Keep my soul, for I am true to you; O my God, give salvation to your servant, whose hope is in you.
求你保存我的性命，因我是虔誠人。我的神啊，求你拯救這倚靠你的僕人！
Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.
Have mercy on me, O Lord; for my cry goes up to you all the day.
主啊，求你憐憫我，因我終日求告你。
Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
Make glad the soul of your servant; for it is lifted up to you, O Lord.
主啊，求你使僕人心裡歡喜，因為我的心仰望你。
For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
You are good, O Lord, and full of forgiveness; your mercy is great to all who make their cry to you.
主啊，你本為良善，樂意饒恕人，有豐盛的慈愛賜給凡求告你的人。
Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.
O Lord, give ear to my prayer; and take note of the sound of my requests.
耶和華啊，求你留心聽我的禱告，垂聽我懇求的聲音。
In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.
In the day of my trouble I send up my cry to you; for you will give me an answer.
我在患難之日要求告你，因為你必應允我。
O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.
There is no god like you, O Lord; there are no works like your works.
主啊，諸神之中沒有可比你的；你的作為也無可比。
All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.
Let all the nations whom you have made come and give worship to you, O Lord, giving glory to your name.
主啊，你所造的萬民都要來敬拜你；他們也要榮耀你的名。
For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.
For you are great, and do great works of wonder; you only are God.
因你為大，且行奇妙的事；惟獨你是神。
Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
Make your way clear to me, O Lord; I will go on my way in your faith: let my heart be glad in the fear of your name.
耶和華啊，求你將你的道指教我；我要照你的真理行；求你使我專心敬畏你的名！
I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
I will give you praise, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will give glory to your name for ever.
主─我的神啊，我要一心稱讚你；我要榮耀你的名，直到永遠。
For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
For your mercy to me is great; you have taken my soul up from the deep places of the underworld.
因為，你向我發的慈愛是大的；你救了我的靈魂免入極深的陰間。
The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life, with no regard for You.
O God, men of pride have come up against me, and the army of violent men would take my life; they have not put you before them.
神啊，驕傲的人起來攻擊我，又有一黨強橫的人尋索我的命；他們沒有將你放在眼中。
But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
But you, O Lord, are a God full of pity and forgiveness, slow to get angry, great in mercy and wisdom.
主啊，你是有憐憫有恩典的神，不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛和誠實。
Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.
O be turned to me and have mercy on me: give your strength to your servant, and your salvation to the son of her who is your servant.
求你向我轉臉，憐恤我，將你的力量賜給僕人，救你婢女的兒子。
Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
Give me a sign for good; so that my haters may see it and be shamed; because you, Lord, have been my help and comfort.
求你向我顯出恩待我的憑據，叫恨我的人看見便羞愧，因為你─耶和華幫助我，安慰我。
